expectedRealization.rationale: Battery demand, share and capacity expansion are multi-year, but the stock and baseline already price substantial compounding.

changeHypothesis.summary: China NEV sales and production were accelerating at triple-digit rates and CATL Q1 profit grew 163%, confirming a structural battery demand engine. However, the stock was sustained_strength and the contemporaneous baseline already priced 2021-23 profit growth of +65%/+34%/+29% at roughly 93x/69x/54x PE.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: EV penetration and battery capacity build are multi-year structural trends.
disconfirmingEvidence: Forward PE remained very high across the path.
Raw-material inflation was already identified as a margin risk.
The stock had strongly outperformed over both 20d and 60d.

causalChain.mechanism: Triple-digit NEV volume growth increases installed battery demand.
causalChain.failureMode: EV demand slows or policy support weakens

causalChain.mechanism: Global scale, customer base and planned capacity support high shipment growth.
High growth creates alpha only if earnings outgrow a baseline already pricing strong multi-year compounding.
causalChain.failureMode: great execution merely meets a premium baseline

selectionComparison.rationale: CATL is the clearest structural-growth expression, but expectation burden blocks High-priority.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The Apr29 baseline expected 2021-23 profit growth +65%/+34%/+29% at about 93x/69x/54x PE, and the stock had strongly outperformed across both 20d and 60d.
expectations.thesisExpectation: EV demand and capacity expansion could keep compounding above this already-high path.
expectations.measurableGap: The required gap is not 'EVs grow fast'; it is whether CATL beats an already-aggressive multi-year forecast enough to justify the premium duration.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Multi-year earnings-duration path and forward PE.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Share, capacity and storage expansion push 2022-23 earnings materially above baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Growth must stay high for multiple years without margin compression; simple delivery of the published path is insufficient.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: EV demand stays excellent but earnings merely meet baseline, causing duration/multiple compression.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Monthly installations, capacity milestones and H1 earnings can test the path.
